name: Webamp Desktop [anylinux]
description:
Webamp Desktop is a cross-platform desktop application recreating the classic Winamp 2.9 media player using HTML5, Web Audio, and Webamp. It brings the beloved retro audio player experience to modern Linux.

Features:
- Faithful recreation of the classic Winamp 2.9 interface, equalizer, and playlist editor
- Full support for thousands of vintage Winamp skins (.wsz) with instant switching
- Integrated Milkdrop visualization engine with hundreds of hypnotic visual presets
- High-quality audio playback for MP3, FLAC, WAV, and streaming internet radio
- Lightweight desktop footprint with global media hotkeys and playlist management

This is an unofficial AnyLinux AppImage, which is able to work anywhere including glibc and musl. For more info: https://pkgforge-dev.github.io/Anylinux-AppImages/
